name: beatfall-test
description: The root package.json declares type=module. These suites are CommonJS and use require(), so without this file `node mkstub.js` fails on its first line and the suite cannot be run from a clean clone. Nothing here is installed or shipped. playwright runs the suites; jspdf is the real PDF library, used only by render-pdf.js, which is not part of the suite and exists so somebody changing the document can look at what they made.
